version_or_release: UCI static archive downloaded 2026-11-05; original repository record donated 1988-06-30
role: Exploratory retrospective leave-one-source-out evaluation; not independent external validation
target_definition: num=0 is absence; num=1,2,3,4 are presence. The UCI description defines presence as greater than 50% diameter narrowing in a major coronary vessel.
overlap_assessment: The Five States/heart5 project source is documented as a composite of Cleveland, Hungarian, Switzerland, Long Beach VA, and Statlog sources. These UCI cohorts therefore overlap data already used in the project; row-level patient linkage cannot be re-established from the composite.

preprocessing_policy.imputation: numeric median and categorical most-frequent, fitted on source training rows only

attribution: Janosi, A., Steinbrunn, W., Pfisterer, M., and Detrano, R. (1989). Heart Disease. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI: 10.24432/C52P4X.
